v: First hour ‘What the F***’... next hour ‘WHAT A F***’ 😂 Romance almost lost me, but shift ayyaka full BANG. Chaitanya best performance till then for me.
e: Sahasam Swasaga Sagipo is a sharply divided experience for me: the romantic first hour was painful because that genre rarely works for me, while the later semi-action stretch suddenly becomes gripping. Naga Chaitanya gives what I felt was his best performance to that point, the BGM is superb and the much-criticised climax actually felt realistic to me.
body:
awesome transformation from What the F*** to What a F*** …… n the 4 letter wrd starting with F doesnt stands for Film 😛

first 1 hr was horrible!!! (at least from my perapective as I am not a fan of romace genere) but later on its a BANG!!! seen many reviews stating the climax was week but personally i loved it and thought it was more realistic

undoubtedly NagChaitanya’s best performace till date….heroine was apt and so as other chars

BGM was superb…..Music is ok (again i am not a fan of Rahman’s slow n romantic songs) but lyrics is disgusting (always had this feeling for Rahman’s songs starting with Boy’s)

Vellipomake song ayithe literally audience ki chepinatu undhi…vellipomakandi ikada nunchi cinema superb ga untundhi ani 😛

overall good movie for semi-action movie lovers if they can bear the first 1hr….but i feel concept n story were realistic right from word go

v: Pure romance usually naaku nidra teppisthundi 😄 Premam మాత్రం comedy + emotion balance tho keep chesindi. Naa Autograph minus heavy sentiment, plus easy fun.
e: I had not watched the Malayalam original, so I entered the Telugu Premam without comparison baggage. Naga Chaitanya delivers one of his better performances, Shruti Haasan is effortless, the music and visuals suit the story, and Praveen’s comedy becomes the crucial ingredient that keeps a romance-averse viewer like me happily involved.
body:
I havent watched the original version so my thought was not pre-programmed……Need to mention 4 main ppl, NagaChaitanya has tried his best and mostly succedded in giving best performance till date and was stylish in remaining 2 getups.

Praween : to be frank, he has carried the whole movie with his comedy timing n expressions

Srinivas : He played a major role during the last 30 mins of the movie

Shruthi Hassan : she played the char with such an ease

music & bgm are good and suites the plot….the visuals in evvare song were delight to watch

Dialogues were verybgood and loved this one “Prema Dvesham Kopam ivani feelings….manam kavalante feelings peruguthayi vadu anukunte tagipothayi”

To cut it short…..Love/Romantic genere movies have always made me feel bore, but this movie has tried to keep me engaged due to its entertainment, probably would have felt horrible for me if the comedy was missing. Its Naa Autograph minus heavy emotions plus light hearted comedy

v: Pure PURI markISM 😄 Dialogue bombs straight MISSILES, second half racy, Kalyan Ram uber-cool. Puri fans ki feast... story మాత్రం vere writer daggara nunchi teesukunte ఇంకా బాగుంటుంది 😂
e: ISM is unmistakably Puri Jagannadh, built around aggressive one-liners, attitude and a much tighter second half. Kalyan Ram looks completely at ease and gives especially strong work later in the film. I enjoyed the Puri flavour enough to recommend it to his audience, even while feeling increasingly that his writing would benefit from bringing other storytellers into the room.
body:

1. Bhoomi meedha prathodiki mudu putla thindhi kavali….aa thindi pandinche raythu akali gurunchi ee naakoduki akarledhu

2. Desam ni Thellollu entha dhochukunaaro theledhu gaani….Sanka nakinchindi mathram mana laage untu mana chutu thirige eee nalla l**** kodukulle

3. nuvu alla chusthunte, body lo unna billion cells excite ayyi….energy ni oke chota ki pump chesthunaayi

4. I am very good at ducking……reyi porapatuna duck ante baathu anukunavemo boothu raaa erri ****

v: Different, mature concept with very quiet emotions. Regular audience ki 2 hoursే 4 hours laga anipinchachu 😄 Different cinema ishtam unte one-time watch worth it.
e: Mana Oori Ramayanam has a distinctive single-point premise and deliberately avoids loud dialogue or commercial decoration. Prakash Raj and Priyamani are predictably strong, while Prudhvi surprises with a serious, mature performance and Ilaiyaraaja’s music fits the restrained mood. Its slow, subtle approach will not connect with everyone, but the experiment deserves appreciation.
body:
Different story and concept with undercover emotions!!! PrakashRaj n Priyamani nailed it with performance (which is expected) but a serious matured performance by Pruthvi (30 yrs industry)…….on though its hardly 2 hrs movie, normal audience feel like the movie is running for ages due to its single point and sublime emotions without heavy dialogues, Music by Illeyaraja is good and fits in the bill.

Though the movie is clean U many may not get connected due to its matured/bold concept. Hatsoff to PrakashRaj for molding such a matured storyline to a clean U movie.

One Time Watch for all those movie lovers who encourage different concept movies.
